# Submission checklist

- [x] Blinded manuscript source assembled.
- [x] Bibliography keys and DOI metadata checked against authoritative records.
- [x] All theorem dependencies classified.
- [x] Analytic proof separated from exact computational cross-check.
- [x] Strict narrative lint passes.
- [x] LaTeX, BibTeX, references, and citations compile.
- [x] PDF metadata, text extraction, and page count validate.
- [x] First, middle, and last page previews generated for visual inspection.
- [x] Frontier language remains at C2.
- [x] Cover letter, venue memo, data statement, and novelty statement supplied.
- [x] Source/certificate archive can be reproduced from the manuscript root.
- [ ] Corresponding author name, affiliation, ORCID, email, funding, and conflict declarations must be supplied by the user before external submission.
- [ ] Refresh subscription database searches immediately before external submission.
